description: I am Muhammad Hasan and I am participating in the Nasa space apps challenge.
summary: Our project is an innovative medical assistance system designed to help astronauts manage their health independently in space. Astronauts can enter symptoms such as fever, coughing, and allergies to identify possible illnesses. The system suggests suitable medications and provides step-by-step instructions for using medical equipment. Its most unique feature is generating a detailed medical report that astronauts can send directly to mission control for further guidance. Our team developed this project using HTML, aiming to make healthcare easier, safer, and more accessible during space missions
details: Our project is designed to help astronauts diagnose their medical conditions independently while in space. It recommends suitable medications and provides step-by-step instructions on how to use medical equipment and tools. What makes our project creative and innovative is its ability to generate a detailed medical report that astronauts can send directly to mission control for further assistance. Our team developed the project using HTML programming and incorporated various symptoms, including fever, coughing, and allergies, to help identify potential health conditions.
